The New York Times on Instagram: "Why go back to the moon anyway? To the four astronauts of Artemis II, the first crewed mission around the moon in more than 50 years, the answer is simple.

Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen each remember looking up at the moon as children, and feeling small. They all felt part of something much greater than themselves. 

They say recreating that feeling is reason enough to go back, even though at home the crew has had firsthand encounters with people who suggest that resources should not be spent that way.

Swipe to meet the Artemis II crew. Then tap the link in our bio to learn more about their mission, which comes during a moment of conflict and division at home and abroad. Illustrations by @psimdope; photos by @cassandraklos_ and Bill Ingalls/NASA, via Agence France-Presse — Getty Images"
